lang.title: Choose your language
lang.hiSample: पक्का करें कि सच में वही हैं।

install.title: Pehchaan
install.lead: Add Pehchaan to your home screen so it opens like an app, full screen, in one tap.
install.iosStep1Hint: The square with an arrow, in Safari's toolbar
install.iosStep2Hint: Scroll the list if you don't see it
install.installed: Pehchaan is on your home screen. Open it from there.
install.inAppTitle: Open this link in Chrome or Safari
install.inAppBody: This app's built-in browser can't install Pehchaan. Copy the link, then paste it into Chrome or Safari.
install.desktopHint: Pehchaan is made for phones. Open this link on your phone to install it.

1.title: Voices can be copied. Phones can't.
1.body: A scammer can sound exactly like your son. They can't unlock his phone.

2.title: During a suspicious call, tap Verify.
2.body: Pehchaan asks their own phone if it's really them.

3.title: Red means don't pay. Green means it's really them.
3.body: Family rule: no green, no money.

name.title: What's your name?
name.hint: Family will see this when you ask or answer.
name.label: Your name
name.phoneHint: Family phones use it for their “Call” buttons.
name.hindiFormHint: Only changes Hindi verb endings (रहा / रही / रहे).
name.errEmpty: Enter your name so family can recognise you.
name.errPhone: Enter a 10-digit mobile number, or leave it empty.

role.title: Could someone pretend to be you?
role.lead: Scammers copy the voices of children and relatives to fool parents.
role.yesHint: For anyone a scammer might copy: children, relatives.

key.title: Create your key
key.body: It stays inside this phone. You unlock it with your fingerprint or PIN.
key.point1: Your key never leaves this phone
key.point2: Only your fingerprint or PIN can use it
key.point3: Family can check it's really you
key.waiting: Use your fingerprint or PIN when your phone asks.
key.done: Your key is ready. It never leaves this phone.
key.wordsCaption: Your family will see these same words when they add you.
key.noLock: Set a screen lock (fingerprint or PIN) in your phone settings, then come back.
key.skipNote: You're set up to check others. You can create your key later in Settings.
key.noPasskey: This phone can't create a key here.
key.cancelled: Key not created. Tap to try again.
key.pinHint: You'll enter it every time you answer a request.
key.pinMismatch: The PINs don't match. Try again.

done.title: You're set up
done.body: Now add your family. Do it together, in person.

notif.title: Get requests even when Pehchaan is closed
notif.body: Pehchaan can show a notification when family asks you to confirm.

home.rule: Family rule: no green, no money.
home.empty: Add the people a scammer might pretend to be.

family.title: Family
family.inperson: Do this together, in person. That's what makes it safe.
family.empty: Add the people a scammer might pretend to be.
family.farAwayBody: Two family members who already have {{name}} must approve before they're added.
family.farAwaySoon: Approvals will be sent once this is available.

myCode.title: My code
myCode.caption: Read these aloud. Their phone must show the same words.
myCode.tip: Turn your brightness up if scanning is slow.

scan.title: Scan their code
scan.instruction: Point at the code on their phone
scan.pasteHint: Paste the family link they sent you, or the code under their QR.
scan.cameraOff: Camera is off for Pehchaan. Paste their code instead, or allow the camera in your browser settings.
scan.noCamera: This device has no camera we can use. Paste their code instead.
scan.notPehchaan: This isn't a Pehchaan code. Ask them to open My code.
scan.own: That's your own code. Scan the other person's phone.
scan.corrupt: This code is incomplete. Ask them to show their code again.

confirm.title: Check it's them
confirm.noPanel: Don't add this person. Scan again, face to face.
confirm.label: What do you call them?
confirm.labelHint: This name shows on your screen when you check them.
confirm.sheetTitle: Now let {{label}} scan your code so you can verify each other
confirm.noCard: Nothing to confirm yet. Scan a code first.

member.removeConfirm: Remove {{label}}? You won't be able to verify them until you add them again.
member.notFound: This person isn't in your family list any more.

join.shared: {{name}} shared their Pehchaan card with you.
join.sharedGeneric: Someone shared their Pehchaan card with you.
join.yourNameHint: Optional. {{name}} will see this when you check them.
join.wordsAsk: Do these match the words on {{name}}'s phone?
join.saved: Saved. You can now check {{name}} anytime.
join.corrupt: This link is incomplete. Ask them to show their code again.
join.notPehchaan: This isn't a Pehchaan code. Ask them to open My code.
join.own: That's your own card. Share it with someone else.
join.oldBrowser: Open this in Chrome or Safari.
join.noMatch: Don't add this person. Scan again, face to face.

verify.who: Who does the caller say they are?
verify.offline: You're offline, so we can't check right now. Don't pay until you can.
verify.noMembers: No one in your family can be verified yet. Add a child or relative who has set up their key.

payment.title: Payment check
payment.question: You're sending {{amount}} to a new person right after a call. Did someone on the phone ask you to?

wait.title: Asking {{name}}'s phone…
wait.say: Tell the caller: “Please hold for a minute.”
wait.calm: Scammers rush. Real emergencies can wait a minute.
wait.cancelConfirm: Stop waiting? {{name}} won't be able to answer this request.

official.title: Real police never arrest anyone over a video call
official.rule1: CBI, ED and police don't do “digital arrest” over video calls.
official.rule2: No real officer asks you to transfer money to “verify” it.
official.rule3: Never share OTPs or install apps a caller asks for.

denied.title: Not {{name}}
denied.body: {{name}}'s own phone says this is not them.

none.title: Not confirmed yet
none.body: {{name}} hasn't answered. Don't pay until they do.

fake.title: Fake answer
fake.body: Someone tried to fake {{name}}'s answer. Do not trust this call.

unknown.title: Can't verify
unknown.body: This person isn't in your family list, so we can't check them. Treat the caller as unverified.
unknown.advice3: Call back on a number you already know

v.say: What to say to the caller
v.sayLine: “I'll call you back on your usual number.”
v.sayLineHint: Then hang up and call {{name}} on the number you already have.
v.sayWordsCaption: Their phone shows the same two words.
v.familyNone: No one else in your family list to alert
v.familyFailed: Couldn't alert family. Call them yourself.
v.closeQBody: You'll find it later in History.

reasons.changed: The answer was changed on the way.
reasons.reused: An old answer was sent again.
reasons.wrong_key: It was signed by a key that isn't {{name}}'s.
reasons.wrong_app: It didn't come from the Pehchaan app.
reasons.not_unlocked: The phone wasn't unlocked to answer.
reasons.expired: The answer arrived after the request expired.

why.footnote: {{name}}'s phone signed this answer. Our server only passed it along; it can't create or change a signature.

fail.no_pending: No request of ours was waiting for this answer.
fail.expired: It arrived after the request expired.
fail.unknown_key: The key isn't the one saved for {{name}}.
fail.mismatch: The request or decision was changed after signing.
fail.wrong_origin: It was signed for a different website.
fail.not_verified: The phone wasn't unlocked with a fingerprint or PIN.
fail.bad: The signature doesn't verify with {{name}}'s key.
fail.used: This exact answer was already used once.

ask.title: {{asker}} is asking

q.money: Are YOU on a call with them right now, asking for {{amount}}?
q.moneyNoAmount: Are YOU on a call with them right now, asking for money?
q.otp: Are YOU on a call with them right now, asking for an OTP or code?
q.bank: Are YOU on a call with them right now, asking for bank or card details?
q.app: Are YOU on a call with them right now, asking them to install an app?
q.none: Are YOU on a call with them right now?

ask.caption: You'll unlock with your fingerprint or PIN.
ask.expired: This request expired. If {{asker}} still needs you, they can ask again.
ask.notConfirmed: Not confirmed. Tap to try again.
ask.waitingUnlock: Waiting for your fingerprint or PIN…
ask.noKey: This phone has no key yet, so it can't answer. Create your key in Settings.
ask.gone: This request is no longer here.

no.title: We told {{asker}} it's not you
no.body: Someone may be pretending to be you. Call {{asker}} now.

yes.title: {{asker}} can see it's really you
yes.wordsCaption: Their phone shows the same two words.

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.empty: No alerts. Pehchaan tells you here if someone pretends to be a family member.

checkOn.title: Can you check on {{about}}?
checkOn.body: {{victim}} couldn't confirm a money request from someone claiming to be {{about}}. Can you reach {{about}}?

history.title: History
history.empty: Nothing yet. Your checks and answers will appear here.

historyDetail.title: Details
historyDetail.deleteConfirm: Delete this entry? This can't be undone.
historyDetail.noChecks: No answer was checked for this entry.

settings.title: Settings
settings.notifications: Requests arrive while Pehchaan is open
settings.storedBody: Your profile, your family's cards, your history and alerts. Never call recordings. Nothing is kept on a server: our server only passes messages between phones.

profileEdit.title: Profile
profileEdit.note: Family members keep the name they saved. Share your code again after changing it.

myKey.title: My key
myKey.noKey: No key on this phone yet.
myKey.toggleHint: When off, your family can't check calls in your name.
myKey.offConfirm: Family won't be able to verify you until you turn this on and share your code again.
myKey.replaceConfirm: Your family will need to scan your new code.
myKey.replaced: New key ready. Share your code again.

display.title: Display
display.soundsHint: Soft chimes for requests and results.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.step4_you: Your phone checks the signed answer
howItWorks.voiceTitle: Why a copied voice can't pass
howItWorks.voiceBody: The check never listens to the voice. Only the key inside {{person}}'s phone can answer, and only after they unlock it with their fingerprint or PIN.
howItWorks.serverTitle: What our server can and can't do
howItWorks.serverBody2: It can't create or change a signed answer.
howItWorks.serverBody3: If it fails, you see “Not confirmed yet”, never green.
howItWorks.voiceBody_you: The check never listens to the voice. Only the key inside your phone can answer, and only after you unlock it with your fingerprint or PIN.

limits.title: What Pehchaan can't protect against
limits.card1Body: A PIN is a key too. Keep it private, even within the family.
limits.card2: Harmful apps already on your phone
limits.card2Body: Only install apps from the Play Store or App Store, and never because a caller asked.
limits.card3: A family member being forced to say yes
limits.card3Body: If something feels wrong even after green, call them back on their usual number.
limits.card4: People who aren't in your family list
limits.card4Body: Pehchaan can only check people you added in person.
limits.closing: Pehchaan confirms who answered. It can't tell whether they're safe. In an emergency, call 112.

suspicious.title: During a suspicious call
suspicious.step1: Pause. Real emergencies can wait a minute.
suspicious.step3: Never share an OTP or install an app a caller asks for.
suspicious.step4: Call back on a number you already know.

deleteAll.title: Delete all data
deleteAll.body: This removes everything Pehchaan keeps on this phone:
deleteAll.note: Your family will need to add you again.

practice.title: Practice a scam call
practice.coachHint: Pehchaan asks their own phone. Try it now.
practice.verdictBody: In a real call, {{name}}'s phone would say this is not them. Hang up and call them yourself.

diag.title: Diagnostics
diag.name: Name
diag.clearConfirm: Clear all requests, history and alerts on this phone? Family and settings stay.

auto.off: Off (a real person answers in another tab)

lab.title: Security Lab
lab.attackerOn: The relay is controlled by the attacker
lab.armed: Armed: waiting for the next check from {{name}}'s phone

change.title: Change the next answer
change.body: Turns {{name}}'s NOT ME into ME on the way

replay.title: Replay {{name}}'s last yes
replay.body: Sends their genuine “Yes” from earlier instead of asking them
replay.disabled: Run one genuine check first so there's a real “Yes” to replay

forge.title: Forge a yes
forge.body: Answers “Yes” using the attacker's own key

lab.resultIdle: Arm an attack, then check {{name}} from {{asker}}'s phone.
lab.resultWaiting: Attack sent. Waiting for {{asker}}'s phone to check it…
lab.empty: No traffic yet. Open two phone tabs and run a check.
lab.wide: The Security Lab is made for a laptop screen.

guard.title: Call Guard
guard.transcriptEmpty: Press Start. Put the call on speakerphone near this laptop.
guard.autoSendHint: Sends once there's an identity claim and the stage reaches Money.
guard.needClaim: Waiting for the caller to claim a name
guard.rulesHint: Every rule Call Guard uses, in plain text.
guard.footer: Call Guard only suggests a check. It never decides who is calling.
guard.micUnsupported: Live listening needs Chrome. Use Scripted mode.
guard.micDenied: The microphone is blocked. Allow it in the browser, or use Scripted mode.
guard.wide: Call Guard is made for a laptop screen.
